The Mathematics of the Sacred: Corn Divination
The Reveal:
Pile of 5 kernels
Single kernel
Step 1:
13 total kernels (the
holiest number) are
shuffled on the
wooden mesa.
Step 2:
The pile is divided.
The i-meen extracts
groups of 5 kernels.
Step 3:
The remaining single
kernels (1, 4, 1, 2, 1, 5, 2)
are arranged in an arc
across the top of the table.
The modern corn arrangement
is a literal mathematical
calculation of remedies,
directly mirroring the ancient
Precolumbian Maya numbering
system (bars and dots).

The Physics of the Sáastun
The Mechanic:
A cross-section of a glass sphere
filled with internal air bubbles. The
shaman rotates the glass until
candlelight aligns precisely with the
defects, causing them to flash.
The Interpretation:
Flashes are not literal images.
They are read as the little holes in
the sky' where the santo winklil
(holy ones/angels) communicate
their sanctioning signs.

The rural j-meen is not practicing haphazard folk superstition. Whether arranging corn kernels by fives and
ones, or consulting a frayed Book of Oracles, the modern shaman is performing the exact same mathematical
and cosmological calculations as the ancient priests consulting the sacred hieroglyphic books. The medium
